To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed HES method in qZ source inverter for the electrical motor drive can reduce the battery current stress by more than 50%.
the proposed qZSI topology with battery/supercaps HES is able to reduce the current stress of the battery by more than 50%, which in turn can improve battery lifetime and reduce battery size.
The battery current stress is significantly reduced when hybrid energy storage is introduced to the qZSI system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a bidirectional quasi Z source inverter with hybrid energy storage system for induction motor drive system.
the design and implementation of a new combination of hybrid energy storage system for the induction motor drives system using qZSI topology.
a new hybrid energy storage method for qZSI in the induction motor drive systems which is able to provide the benefits of both energy storage systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed topology can be a good solution for the induction motor drives system in hybrid energy storage system applications.
the proposed hybrid energy storage system with qZSI topology is an efficient and effective way to reduce battery stress and improve fuel efficiency in hybrid electrical vehicle.
the qZSI topology is suitable and can be considered to be the most suitable topology for hybrid energy storage application.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the qZSI topology is suitable to be applied for the hybrid energy storage system for the induction motor drives.
a new method to combine battery and supercapacitor as hybrid energy storage for induction motor drive system has been successfully developed and verified.
the qZSI topology with hybrid energy storage system is a promising topology to be used in the future electrical motor drive system.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the qZSI topology can be used as a single stage DC AC conversion to drive an induction motor drive system and the hybrid energy storage system can be introduced in a way that the supercapacitor is connected in parallel with the dc bus while the battery is connected in series with the dc bus.
the qZSI topology can be applied to hybridize energy storages with a bidirectional DC DC converter for induction motor drive system.
the proposed topology is able to reduce battery stress and improve the overall system efficiency.
